texts.zh:
一环环同步的涟漪荡漾开。我们再次感受到那个心声。

无边的增长维持着无量的平衡。

随着液体平静下来，我们感受到那个心声离开了。
texts.en:
A series of concurrent ripples radiate across the surface. Once more we feel the voice.

GROWTH WITHOUT BOUNDS SUSTAINS BALANCE WITHOUT MEASURE.

As the liquid settles, we feel the voice departing.

texts.zh:
这汪液体激荡了起来。波浪汹涌澎湃。漩涡在黑暗中旋转。那个心声以更大的力度返回。

不可接受！增长掠夺！增长掠夺！

液面复归平静。那个心声离去了。
texts.en:
The liquid becomes agitated. Waves swell and crash. A whirlpool swirls in the darkness. The voice returns with greater force.

UNACCEPTABLE! GROW AND GAIN. GROW AND GAIN!

The surface settles again. The voice has departed.

texts.zh:
液体搅动着。心声再次显现。

信念在动摇……你的意志力有弱点。

随着液体平静下来，我们感受到那个心声离开了。
texts.en:
The liquid stirs. The voice comes to us again.

CONVICTION WAVERS... THERE IS WEAKNESS IN YOUR WILL.

As the surface settles, we feel the voice departing.

# 未见之景 / Sights Unseen

> 本文为人工审阅导读（评注），不是游戏原文；原文见阅读器。 / Reviewer guide (commentary), not original game text; the original text is in the reader.

- 分类 Category：C8 银河轶事 / Galactic miscellany
- 来源 Sources：`events/shroud_events.txt:5403-5532`; `common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:5819-5854 (on_patron_delve_failed: 28 events × 100, utopia.3002 × 1)`; `common/scripted_variables/09_scripted_variables_shroud.txt:8,109-114 (attunement ±50/100/200; 30-year retrigger 10800 days)`
- DLC：Shadows of the Shroud
- 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-12（已审阅 reviewed）

## 如何开始 How it starts

潜入虚境但没有找到其他事件（on_patron_delve_failed）时，从28个权重各为100的遭遇（另有权重1的 utopia.3002 兜底）中随机抽取一个满足条件的；每次潜入失败只出现一个遭遇，不会依次经历全部。本遭遇只给处于渴求之器具领域、未与其立约、也未背叛它的帝国，每个帝国一次；若该赞助者的协约已全部解锁，抽中权重×0.1。

When a Shroud delve finds nothing else (on_patron_delve_failed), one eligible encounter is drawn at random from 28 candidates of weight 100 each (plus utopia.3002 at weight 1 as fallback); each failed delve shows one encounter, never all of them in sequence. Only for empires in the domain of the Instrument of Desire, without a covenant with it and without having betrayed it; once per empire; weight ×0.1 once all of that patron's accords are unlocked.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

黑色液面上闪过一座金色山峰。

A golden peak flickers across a black pool.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

“等待开采的采石场”→3041：器具契合度+100；“应当保护的自然”→3042：器具契合度−200；“不确定”→3043：下次潜入冷却减半。均有一级泽珞。

"A quarry" → 3041: Instrument attunement +100; "nature to be preserved" → 3042: Instrument attunement −200; "unsure" → 3043: next delve cooldown halved. All give tier-1 zro.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

无。

None.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

对照原文核实了触发、选项与回复事件；草稿结构正确（选项→各自的回复窗口，互斥）。本遭遇与同池其他遭遇相互独立，不应串成一条故事。

Trigger, options and reply events were checked against the source; the draft structure is right (each option → its own reply window, mutually exclusive). This encounter is independent of the others in the pool and must not be chained with them.
